firm_data.firm_description: Crone Law Group is an international law firm headquartered in New York, focusing on a wide range of practice areas including securities law, corporate finance, and mergers & acquisitions. They maintain a flexible environment to provide high-quality legal services with reasonable rates and tailored service.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in New York, Atlanta, Los Angeles, Reno, and Beijing.
They offer multilingual capabilities in Hebrew, Russian, French, Farsi, Mandarin, and Cantonese.
The firm represents domestic and foreign publicly traded corporations, emerging companies, and entrepreneurs & investors.

email.subject: AI for Crone Law Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Mark,

Your team handles securities law and corporate finance across five offices, from New York to Beijing, which means you're managing complex, high-stakes work across multiple jurisdictions and time zones.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
